name: mastermind like transcriptional coactivator 2
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
positive regulation of transcription of Notch receptor target

function.text: MAML2 encodes mastermind-like protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription of Notch receptor target.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Thymoma; Porocarcinoma; Hidradenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
